description: An illustration, written for this repository's README and tests. It is not the framework's policy and carries no authority: the paper leaves all seven inputs to the verifier. Two persistence types are counted, work (the first signed version of a note or page, or its genesis leaf) and revision (each later version). An epoch is 4320 blocks, about thirty days; a work keeps 9/10 of its contribution per epoch and a revision 3/4. Two attestation types are named, membership and peer, so the output shows each count at zero; the recognition set is empty, and no recognition attestation exists in this ledger for the attestation constants to act on.
